hero.title: Bring a client,
hero.lead: Know a business that needs a website? Introduce us. When they become a client, we thank you properly. Open to everyone: past clients and visitors.

primary.label: Refer someone on WhatsApp
primary.message: Hi Altio, I would like to refer a business to you.

items.title: Introduce them
items.text: Send us their name and WhatsApp, or share our site. Always ask them first.

items.title: They become a client
items.text: We design their homepage for free. If they love it, the project starts.

items.title: You get rewarded
items.text: Once they have fully paid, we agree your reward together.

rewards.title: You pick what suits you
rewards.lead: Amounts are agreed case by case, depending on the project.

items.title: Credit
items.text: Money off your own next project.

items.title: Cash
items.text: A direct payment, agreed with you.

rules: Reward is given after the referred client has fully paid
We never contact anyone without their consent
Altio may withhold rewards in case of abuse

form.title: Refer someone
form.subtitle: Takes one minute. We contact them only if they agree.
form.note: This opens WhatsApp with your answers filled in, ready to send.

errors.yourPhone: Enter a number we can reach on WhatsApp.
errors.theirName: Tell us who you are referring.
